phase: Root-adopted Arcane Vision text/test/native-capture source, verified locally; next source CI pending.
scope: One remaining ordinary Arcane Vision activation facet. No gameplay, eligibility, damage, duration, save, signing or detailed-panel change.
final_ordinary_description:
_+1:_ Qualifying wand effects let the Mage track affected creatures with mind vision for _10 turns_.

_+2:_ Qualifying wand effects let the Mage track affected creatures with mind vision for _15 turns_.

This also works when Transfusion targets allies and when wards hit surviving targets. Frost does not trigger this against a target that is already frozen.
actual_handler_coverage: Concrete WandOfFrost.onZap at ranks 0/1/2, both non-Frozen and already-Frozen targets. Real damage/Chill occur only on the qualifying path; moved target awareness/FOV appears only with rank and a qualifying effect.

Concrete WandOfTransfusion.onZap on an allied Rat at ranks 0/1/2. Actual ally healing and caster HP cost execute unchanged. After the ally moves beyond ordinary sight, actual Level.updateFieldOfView reveals its 3x3 footprint only with Arcane Vision.

Ward subclass exposes only controlled enemy selection and calls super.canAttack/super.doAttack. Actual animation request is observed, then actual Ward.onZapComplete performs damage, surviving-target wandProc, totalZaps increment and its next call. Hero time is unchanged. The pre-attack negative FOV check includes intrinsic ward shared sight, avoiding a false positive.

wording_review.initial_clause_not_adopted: A zap that has no effect, such as Frost against an already-frozen target, does not trigger it.
wording_review.reason_for_narrowing: Only the concrete Frost early-return case is established. WandOfTransfusion.onZap invokes wandProc for every Mob before its ally/charmed/enemy effect selection, so awareness is not globally conditioned on another wand effect. A neutral, uncharmed, non-Mimic Mob follows that order without the later heal/charm/damage branches.
wording_review.final_specific_exception: Frost does not trigger this against a target that is already frozen.
wording_review.final_positive_paths: This also works when Transfusion targets allies and when wards hit surviving targets.
wording_review.root_reason: Do not imply that actual HP healing is necessary: the same unconditional wandProc precedes ally healing/shielding and custom-healing-zero outcomes. This sentence describes targeting, without changing any effect.

findings.finding: Frost uses the actual onZap early return on an already-frozen target, checks HP/Frost/Chill, and verifies exact target awareness and a nine-cell FOV footprint after moving beyond normal sight. Rank0 and frozen controls prevent intrinsic sight from passing as Arcane Vision.

The exact Transfusion handler must increase ally HP and reduce caster HP while preserving alignment. The target is moved beyond ordinary sight; target-specific awareness and actual Level.updateFieldOfView then require the talent at ranks1/2 and reject it at rank0.

The wrapper only selects the target and exposes actual canAttack/doAttack. The test checks the real animation request, invokes actual onZapComplete, verifies damage/totalZaps and unchanged hero cooldown, then checks actual awareness/FOV. The pre-attack assertion includes the ward shared FOV with shortened vision, so the later visibility cannot pass merely because a ward is present.

The fixture replaces the Actor registries and clock rather than mutating the saved objects. It restores those fields, Item.curUser, Dungeon hero/level/depth/branch/challenges/custom rules, GameScene scene/cell selector, the prior level PathFinder size and the pushed RNG generator. Temporary emitters/sprites omit only drawing. The tests do not run Actor.process or change its thread-alive flag.

limits: Quiet sprite/particle implementations omit texture construction, particle creation, animation and status drawing only. Gameplay damage, healing, awareness attachment and FOV are not overridden.
The real CellSelector.resetKeyHold runs on an instance allocated without its tilemap-rendering constructor so real Hero.interrupt remains exercised during Transfusion self-damage.
Wand impact callbacks are invoked directly after a real Ballistica; this is not item selection, charge spending, projectile animation, or an Android run.
The Ward target is controlled and its production completion callback is invoked after the animation request; AI enemy selection and a full actor scheduler turn are not claimed.
No new expiry clock or factor sweep was performed. The completed 10/15-turn duration review is reused.
Cursed Wand and other owner-decision scopes were not opened.
The integrated full local suite passed; source CI, Android compilation and exact later APK native/manual acceptance remain separate pending gates.
The earlier isolated receipt records its original unintegrated status and is preserved unchanged rather than rewritten.
